personality_one_liner: A cinematic, expensive workforce command center tailored for premium jewellery management, using deep charcoal and antique gold to project authority and elegance.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for luxury feel, but tight enough within cards for dashboard utility. Elements never sit under safe areas.

do's: Apply to sticky headers, bottom tab bar, and hero cards.
Pair blur with a translucent tinted base (≥75% of surface) underneath to guarantee foreground readability.
Use over the abstract dark gold textures to create a premium, layered depth.
dont's: Do not apply glass to body content, form fields, or standard list rows.
Never rely on blur alone for contrast; the tinted scrim is mandatory.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure authentication for the owner with a high-end brand introduction.

states.loading: Centered gold spinner over the background.
states.error: Standard error toast with retry on top of the form.

screens.layout: Full-screen cinematic background (diamond ring photography) covered with a dark vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 90% surface at bottom). The form sits in the bottom 40% of the screen. Input fields use surfaceTertiary background. Solid brandPrimary CTA sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: The owner's daily command center for workforce and payroll metrics.

states.loading: Skeleton blocks mimicking the bento grid.
states.empty: No activity yet - subtle illustration with a prompt to add employees.
states.error: Error loading metrics - clear reload button.

screens.layout: Top area: Glass hero card over abstract dark gold texture displaying 'Today\'s Attendance' (Present/Absent/Late tiles). Below, a 'Pending Approvals' section (Leave/Salary Advances) using sleek list rows. Bottom section: 'Payroll Summary' using a 2-column bento grid format. Keep scrolling smooth; tab bar sits in a glass container over content.

screens.name: EmployeeList
screens.purpose: A searchable, structured directory of all staff.

states.empty: No employees found - 'Add Employee' prominent CTA.
states.error: Failed to load directory - retry button.

screens.layout: Glass header with a large serif title and a search bar. The list uses generous list rows (minimum 56pt height) with employee avatars, names in Geist 500, roles in secondary text, and right-aligned status chips (e.g., Working, Leave). Floating Action Button (FAB) in brandPrimary for adding an employee.

screens.name: EmployeeProfile
screens.purpose: Deep dive into an employee's history, timeline, and documents.

states.loading: Skeleton for profile header and timeline.
states.error: Failed to load profile - retry button.

screens.layout: Hero cover banner using the abstract dark gold texture with a gradient-to-dark scrim. The employee's avatar overlaps the banner edge. Below, a clean header with Name (Cormorant Garamond) and Designation. Segmented control (glass) to switch between 'Timeline', 'Details', 'Payroll'. The Timeline tab shows a vertical connected list of events (Joined, Advance Taken, Leave) using brandTertiary tinted icons.

screens.name: AddEditEmployee
screens.purpose: Form to onboard new staff or update details.

states.error: Form validation errors displayed below respective fields.

screens.layout: Single column form inside KeyboardAvoidingView. Labels sit above inputs. Grouped sections (Personal, Job Details, Bank). The submit button ('Save Employee') is pinned at the bottom, outside the scroll view, backed by a surface-colored gradient fade to ensure it's always accessible.

login_hero.alt: Diamond ring showcasing premium jewellery quality

abstract_gold_texture.alt: Textured abstract dark gold metallic background

employee_avatar_1.alt: Portrait of a modern professional employee

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the Glass / Luxe DARK theme consistently. Ensure midnight black (#0D0D0D) is the root background.
Implement the gradient scrim pattern (transparent to 90% surfaceInverse) over ALL background imagery (Login hero, Profile cover) before overlaying text.
For the Dashboard 'Today's Attendance' hero card, apply 'expo-blur' (glass) overlaid on top of the 'abstract_gold_texture' image, creating a premium depth effect.
Do not use generic blue or purple defaults anywhere; rely solely on the provided dark charcoal and antique gold palette.

Typography hierarchy: Use 'Cormorant Garamond' (serif) exclusively for large display titles (e.g., Dashboard greeting, Profile name) and 'Geist' (sans-serif) for all body, labels, lists, and metadata.
Maintain high readability. Ensure any text placed over the gold textures uses strong contrast, ideally backed by a dark tinted surface (>75% opacity).
Pin the primary CTA (Save/Submit) at the bottom for Add/Edit Employee screens above the safe area, wrapped in a fixed view so users don't have to scroll to act.
